conclusion: The Japanese SBIC references resolve to the Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation company system, with three separate regional legal companies: Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka. 'East/Central/West' is regional shorthand, not the legal company names. These entities are not SBI Holdings, Inc. The reviewed Tokyo SBIC ChatGPT pages document training/seminars, not an OpenAI, Microsoft or SBI Holdings corporate partnership.

evidence_for_separation: METI and the SME Agency list the three SME investment-development companies separately under their full legal names and separate websites.
SBI Holdings' first-party profile identifies a different company established in 1999 with TSE ticker 8473 and a holding-company business.
No parent, subsidiary, equity or shared-control relationship between the SBIC companies and SBI Holdings was established by the reviewed primary sources.
